positions.title: Software Engineering / Data Scientist Intern
positions.description:
Day-to-day activities involve working on research teams that develop code for modeling risk.
Below are some specific projects.

- Developed and implemented a unit-testing system resulting in code that stays flexible, maintainable, and reusable. Tests enable change, and lack of tests enable rot.
- Created a datasets module to complement the unit-testing system for ease of dataset access. Users are familiar with Scikit-learn so the module was built to function very similarly to Scikit-learn but with extra functionality.
- Developed an expandable code cleanliness tool with multiple functions that can autoformat, check for redundant/unused/overused variable names, check if documentation is reasonable, run unit-tests if available, etc.
- Developed a log-parsing tool that will sift through and organize unstructured data resulting in the ability to see metrics of user code usage and determine actionable insights.
- Developed a connector to between a telemetry logger and an Oracle database.
- Designed and developed a UI for an Oracle database. Throughput and network load were taken into consideration; repeat requests were hashed and requested data was stored as a parquet file and a URL was returned.
- Due to favorable outcomes and interest, requests for similar tools and testing infrastructure have been made from other teams resulting in increased adoption of scalable and clean coding standards.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a member in an agile team with a wide variety of tasks. One sprint might consist of automating the creation of a VM in a specific cloud environment while another sprint might consist of updating the software inside of the docker images used in pipelines.
